## Current positions and affiliations

**Doctoral Researcher in Economics**, KU Leuven · 2021–present  
Fields: Industrial Organization, Macroeconomics, International Trade<br>
Research focus: Market power, production networks, innovation and aggregate welfare<br>
Approach: Firm-level empirical analysis and economic modelling<br>
Adviser: Prof. Johannes Van Biesebroeck<br>
Dissertation: *Market Power in Value Chains*<br>
Expected completion: Spring 2027

**External Researcher**, National Bank of Belgium · 2022–present
